usage: Used for the natural material that plants grow in; common in gardening, farming, and science contexts.
Often appears with verbs like 換, 加, 整, or 種 when talking about preparing or improving a planting area.
A neutral, everyday noun in Hong Kong Cantonese; not very formal, and it is more common than using a technical word in casual speech.
When talking about potted plants, people often mention 土壤 together with 水份, 透氣, or 施肥 to describe plant care.
